validation_notes: Processed 14 unique people from ROSN CSV rows and 15 CSV rows including Igor Sechin's duplicate CEO/Board entries. Checked 2 local ROSN documents: 2024 annual report and 2024 summarized consolidated financial statements. Performed 1 documented research round per person plus overview. Education was not confirmed for Valentin Mamayev, Yegor Filippov, Hamad Al-Mohannadi and Pedro A. Aquino. Weak sources were used for current management/executive status of Lazarev, Mamayev, Filippov and Latypov because Rosneft's 2024 local annual report does not disclose Management Board details under disclosure restrictions. Main conflict: CSV board composition differs from official Rosneft 28 June 2024 board composition; Alexander Uss and Vladimir Litvinenko are kept because they are in CSV, but official 2024 Board list excludes them. CSV labels Alexander Nekipelov as Chairman, while Rosneft materials indicate Mohammed Al-Sada chaired the Board from June 2023 onward; Al-Sada was not added to tmt because he is absent from CSV. Namesakes excluded: Ural Ramdrakovich Latypov, unrelated sports/social-media Yegor Filippov profiles, and unrelated Pedro Aquino records. Search considered complete because local documents were checked first, official 2024 board source was found, older official reports/university/government sources confirmed available education facts, and unresolved fields are left null or empty rather than inferred. QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-31): verified on-disk file against git HEAD baseline (commit f973022, prior corpus restore) -- identical, no post-restore regression found to recover. Fixed 1 simple desync: Maxim Oreshkin's two education entries already stated the degree level in the program field (Bachelor and Master) and in round-1 notes, but qualification_degree was left null; filled both from the existing citation, no new source needed. Corrected 4 mislabeled GICS triples on professional_experience entries where a commercial classification had been applied to a non-classifiable government/legislative/public-university employer or an unverifiable composite entry: Alexander Uss's Krasnoyarsk Krai / Federation Council / Siberian Federal University role (was Consumer Discretionary / Consumer Services / Diversified Consumer Services, now null -- regional government, national legislature and a state university are not commercial GICS entities), Alexander Nekipelov's Moscow School of Economics / MSU directorship (same wrong label, now null -- public state university), Vladimir Litvinenko's Saint Petersburg Mining University rectorship (same wrong label, now null -- public state university), and Petr Lazarev's composite Ministry of Finance USSR / financial institutions / Rosneft Treasury entry (was Financials / Banks / Banks, now null -- combines a Soviet government ministry with Rosneft's own internal treasury function and an unnamed, unverifiable financial institutions placeholder; none of the three named elements is a standalone classifiable bank). Verified as still-correct and left untouched: Akimov-Gazprombank (Banks), Al-Suwaidi Qatargas plus Qatar Petroleum (Energy), Al-Mohannadi Qatar Petroleum plus RasGas (Energy), Aquino Oil and Petroleum Holdings (Energy). Reviewed all documented Contradictions sections (Uss / Litvinenko board-exclusion, Nekipelov chairman conflict, transliteration variants for Al-Suwaidi, Al-Mohannadi and Latypov) and confirmed each was already properly investigated and resolved in round 1 with no new unresolved genuine inconsistency found. Attempted bounded honest-gap follow-up (education) for Mamayev, Filippov, Al-Mohannadi and Aquino with fresh, previously-untried queries, but WebSearch was unavailable this session (shared session budget exhausted at 200 of 200 before any query executed); all four education gaps remain null and unresolved -- see quality_pass_round1_20260731.md for the specific fresh queries queued for a future attempt. No prior facts, descriptions or source citations were shortened or deleted in this round.
